license_note: The official model card, launch announcement, and docs page declare Command A+ available under the Apache 2.0 license with no acceptable-use addendum or noncommercial cap, unlike the CC-BY-NC Command A line. No LICENSE file ships in the weight repositories, so the grant rests on those concordant first-party declarations pointing at the standard Apache-2.0 text.

license_evidence.scope: Command A+ weights as declared on the official model card and docs page, pointing at the standard Apache-2.0 text

access_boundary: This record represents the May 2026 Command A+ release across its three published precisions (bf16, fp8, w4a4), together with the hosted command-a-plus-05-2026 API model and the Azure w4a4 hosting. The Command A base line, other Command variants, and downstream quantizations and fine-tunes remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Ungated weights in three published precisions under a declared Apache-2.0 grant with per-quant serving minima
First-party API plus a documented Azure AI Foundry hosting entry for the exact w4a4 artifact
tradeoffs: No LICENSE file ships beside the weights; the grant rests on card, blog, and docs declarations
218B total parameters need accelerator-class serving outside the W4A4 path
